items.title: Add a narrow orphan surface detector for handler and command registry drift
items.context: The detector should inspect create*Handlers exports, registry registration, command catalog/tool declarations, and runtime command availability. It must have an allowlist for dynamic or intentionally non-command surfaces and must not flag tasks discovered by run-all-smokes.

items.title: Wire the detector into CI-facing package scripts
items.context: Expose a root npm script such as test:orphan-surface that can run after build or against source as a lightweight CI correctness check.

items.title: Retire only high-confidence unused legacy code without deleting dynamic serve/starter support
items.context: Remove or resolve implementation-review old command code, legacy intent-coverage residue, zod bridge half-surface, and generic verifier API files only where import/search evidence proves they are unreachable. Preserve lattice serve and starter devHost-related files.

items.title: Verify build and orphan detector behavior on the real repository
items.context: Run the detector and TypeScript build; record that implementation_review_result_* remains unavailable unless deliberately migrated to modern signed review lanes in a future story.
